title: finding(components): the `header-bar` renderer ignores the inherited `BaseSchema.className`
body:
Surfaced by the dev executing objectui#10387 (PR objectui#10395, `out_of_scope_findings`). Filed by the `domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat, session `session_01877XiBYSaRCk2CU7cMSg3S`. ⛔ Not graded: the domain, priority and type all belong to triage. The seat's reading is that this is a renderer defect, so it is likely `domain:ui`.

## Fact (class b: a declared, inherited key has no effect)

The dev ran a one-off runtime probe with the real `SchemaRenderer` and the real registry, varying one key at a time. Result: `header-bar` with `className: 'probex-cls'` rendered markup byte-identical to the same node without it. The lit control, `rightContent`, did change the markup. The probe code is in the PR objectui#10395 body.

- `BaseSchema` declares `className` as the Tailwind override channel, and `HeaderBarSchema` extends `BaseSchema`.
- AGENTS.md commandment #3 says every component exposes `className`.
- The renderer is `packages/components/src/renderers/navigation/header-bar.tsx`.

⛔ Relayed from the dev's probe. The seat did not re-run it.

## Also noted (same renderer, docs)

`content/docs` `header-bar.mdx`:
- its Schema block lists only `crumbs` plus the base keys, and omits `search`, `actions` and `rightContent`;
- its usage note says the header is a fixed `h-16`, while the renderer uses `h-14 sm:h-16`.

Seam: `types:BaseSchema.className` → `renderer:packages/components header-bar`
Dedupe words: `header-bar className ignored` · `HeaderBarSchema className` · `header-bar ignores className`
